name: Misugi Yuuya
source:
Yukito's roommate and best friend at the Academy. He didn't succeed in getting much info about the academy from the pamphlets but enrolled anyway. His timid personality makes him a figure of fun for Takizawa Mana.

Despite his timidity, Yuuya always shows concern for Yukito and offers help whenever he can.
